$Comment: A Cursed Geode, a find from mining while Hallow's Eve runs. Secondary cracks it open (Hallows_Eve_Cursed_Geode_Crack): one geode is spent, the table Hallows_Eve_Geode_Crack pays out, and the crack counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Crack. The item never checks the calendar, so a geode kept from October still cracks in March. At a Carving Bench it is also the core of the Shattering Lantern Bomb.
